name: react-ub-mode
description: React & TypeScript frontend engineering discipline skill, Antigravity/agent plugin, and deterministic AST quality-gate CLI (crapper, dryer, mutator, react-audit) inspired by unclebob/ub-mode.

scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/tests/*.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && mkdir -p coverage && node --enable-source-maps --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info dist-test/tests/*.test.js
scripts.setup:global: npm run build && npm link && node dist/cli.js setup --copy
